pages.title: Arrow of Time Shard
pages.text: Entropy increases, and that is essentially all that distinguishes the future from the past. This shard is a piece of the arrow itself, pointing the wrong way: nearby, broken things almost seem to want to mend. It is slightly cold, as though it gives up heat.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A negentropy cell reverses local entropy, and a chronon capacitor stores time. Combined with chronon gas in the Chrono Loom, they produced a shard whose arrow pointed backward.

Made in $(item)Chrono Loom$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Temporal Mechanics.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Baryogenesis Seed, Chronal Accelerator, Chronal Anchor, Empirical Notes I, Evolution Engine, Telomerase Complex, Temporal Knot, Temporal Singularity.
